ourostack/gatefold.note: Runs as its own caller (--self, .github/workflows/auto-revert.yml, its own GITHUB_TOKEN): the central PAT gets 403 on its verify branch, so the central cron leaves it alone.

teams-microsoft/tandem.note: Runs as its own caller (--self, .github/workflows/auto-revert.yml, AUTO_REVERT_TOKEN), so the central cron leaves it alone. ci's verdict counts, and so does mac-guards' (main's Mac guards, dispatched on each promoted release's tag), and a confirmed culprit is reverted at once. Never re-runs a main ci run: a release candidate pins its run's first attempt.
